title: King Hezekiah Removes the Bronze Serpent
description: King Hezekiah carried out a religious reform in Judah. He removed the high places, broke down the sacred pillars, cut down the Asherah pole, and smashed to pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because the Israelites had been burning incense to it. It was called Nehushtan.

versions.title: King Hezekiah Removes the Bronze Serpent
versions.description: King Hezekiah carried out a religious reform and among other things smashed the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because the Israelites had been burning incense to it.
versions.reason: [minor] references: The passage 18:1-8 covers the entire introduction of Hezekiah's reign and reform. The actual story about the bronze serpent is concentrated in verse 4, but the context (verses 1-8) gives a complete picture of the reform and his reign. The range is appropriate.
